name: Tendou Taki
source:
[i]It's not a problem. Fighting is my specialty.[/i]

Born and raised in Tokyo.

Kurotori's senior in the Aramatsuri Countermeasures Division.

He is the heir to the Tendō Chibana-shiki Ittō-ryū school (lit. translation "Tendou Blood Flower Style" or "Tendou Lineage Flower Style"), whose home and dojo are located in Yotsuya 3-chome (Yotsuya-sanchome, a neighborhood and major intersection in Shinjuku Ward, Tokyo, centered around Yotsuya-sanchome Station on the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line). His power is of the Amaterasu lineage, capable of annihilating the power of Aramatsuri. The Tendō Chibana-shiki Ittō-ryū has long possessed the power of Amaterasu, and it is almost customary for its swordsmen to join the Countermeasures Division.

Although originally from a family of Onmyōdō practitioners, their ties to Onmyōdō have weakened considerably, and they maintain a distance from the Tsuchimikado faction, which aims to revive Onmyōdō.

He is an extremely strong swordsman, and he still trains at his home dojo about twice a week. He has an earnest and reliable personality.

He lives at home with his parents and younger brother. His older brother disappeared several years ago.

[Translated from [url=https://holicworks.net/tks/cha2.html]Official website[/url]]
